omitted.reason: Pillow 12.3.0 cannot write a 16-bit-per-channel RGB TIFF: Image.fromarray rejects uint16 RGB and Image.frombytes(RGB;16B) yields an 8-bit RGB image. Only the single-channel I;16 mode is written, which is not a colour photo.
